preservedPartialsStageProfile: Optional56Gi stage profile and40-to56Gi planner preserve all failed partials on the existing dedicated haixia/data1 filesystem. Review fresh CSI identity, inactive consumers and the complete226Gi physical budget before separately approved expansion. This does not resize the source PG, allocate restore storage, start an export, increase the24Gi archive cap or relax any source/space/lease protection; initial28Gi manifests and prior32/40Gi artifacts stay unchanged.
deferredRestoreAllocation: 64Gi versetensor scratch remains in exact-storage.json but is excluded from backup-storage.json; not a new CNPG instance or replica
restoreArchiveSelection: BACKUP_ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY defaults to /backup/mtc-pg-logical-20261004 and must match the reviewed restore plan archiveDirectory. A later completed archive can be restored without rewriting the tested shell command. Directory selection does not authorize storage allocation or replace the offhost SHA, markers, independent leases and full restore receipt.
archiveCompression: BACKUP_COMPRESSION defaults to none and can explicitly select zstd:1. Compression runs in the existing pg_dump client, not on the database server. Writer pacing and the24GiB archive cap, physical capacity reserve, 9GiB source start/8GiB floor/512MiB loss/45s leases remain unchanged. Smaller compressed output may shorten client-write backpressure, but production compression ratio, CPU and I/O impact need separate review; this does not authorize another export or bypass source/stage capacity checks.
offhostCopyRate: Default 1MiB/s; BACKUP_COPY_RATE_MIB_PER_SECOND accepts separately reviewed 4 or 8 without changing the 4MiB chunk, hash/resume, capacity or independent CSI leases. Faster pacing is not execution authorization or physical-device QoS; copy reads the completed stage archive, never PGDATA.

sourceProtection.failureAction: Revoke only the export tmpfs lease; existing stage cleanup terminates only its own pg_dump/rate writer. No frontend concurrency, primary, PVC, role or global-setting changes.
sourceProtection.sourceServerTemp: Observe the existing server temp_file_limit without requesting privileged SET, granting parameter privileges, or changing role/global settings. Read-only and lock timeout options remain. The source-volume floor/loss lease bounds the export lifetime, not zero temporary-file creation or unrelated growth between samples.
sourceProtection.dumpLocation: Dedicated 28Gi haixia/data1 volume mounted at /backup; never the source PG PVC
sourceProtection.clientTemporaryLocation: 64Mi memory emptyDir mounted at /tmp for FIFO/logs/lease; source PG PVC is not mounted
sourceProtection.limitation: A read-only dump can delay vacuum; monitoring stops the dump but cannot halt unrelated production growth. Source space still needs independent observation after backup cancellation.

physicalBudget: 4 * logical GiB + 2 GiB per volume: one full head + 2x snapshot limit + one full maintenance copy + metadata. Bookkeeping only; not physical preallocation or a host-wide quota.
